name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 57 - Am 99
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 57 d. Rejects the allocation of appropriations from the EU budget to further militarisation and the reallocation of EU social, regional and economic funds to military expenditure;
